rationale: The short remains structurally aligned: price at $43.00 is still below the 5m 9-EMA ($43.20), session VWAP ($43.87), and sits only 5.7% into today's range, with SPY risk-off and VIX bid. The last five 1m candles show a mild bounce off the $42.82 low, but the move is contained within ~$0.20 (well under the $0.335 ATR) and nowhere near the $43.60 invalidation, so the downtrend read is not yet broken. Flipping long here would fight both the dominant trend and the risk-off tape, and closing would pre-empt a take-profit that is still only ~0.5% away.
